threat.quote: It stars Max Schreck as Count Orlok, a vampire who preys on the wife (Greta Schröder) of his estate agent

threat.detail: spread by rats from his ship
threat.quote: the local doctors attribute to an unspecified plague caused by the rats from the ship

origin.detail: a foreign count from the Carpathians who arrives by ship
origin.quote: When the foreign Orlok arrives in Wisborg by ship, he brings with him a swarm of rats

origin.detail: the makers gave Orlok a lineage from Belial
origin.quote: Orlok is the creation of Belial, one of the Satanic archdemons

wants.quote: Orlok tries to suck the blood out, but his repulsed guest pulls his hand away
Admiring the portrait, the count remarks that she has a "lovely neck"

trigger.detail: Hutter sent to Transylvania to sell a house
trigger.quote: Thomas Hutter is sent to Transylvania by his employer, the eccentric estate agent Herr Knock, to visit a new client, Count Orlok
Orlok signs the documents to purchase the house

rules.quote: a vampire can be destroyed if a pure-hearted woman distracts the vampire from the approaching dawn with her beauty and by offering him her blood of her own free will
the sun rises and its rays cause Orlok to vanish in a puff of smoke
Ellen opens her window to invite Orlok in

who_suffers.detail: Thomas Hutter, the estate agent's clerk
who_suffers.quote: Hutter wakes up the next morning to find fresh punctures on his neck

Many deaths in the town follow Orlok's arrival

ending.quote: the sun rises and its rays cause Orlok to vanish in a puff of smoke
